basicInfo.description: The central authority under DGHS that conducts counseling for 15% All India Quota (AIQ) seats, 100% seats in Deemed/Central Universities, ESIC, AFMC, AIIMS, and JIPMER.
basicInfo.controls: 15% All India Quota (AIQ) seats across state government colleges + 100% seats of central institutes.
basicInfo.ministry: Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

eligibility.qualifyingPercentile: General: 50th Percentile, General-PwD: 45th Percentile, SC/ST/OBC: 40th Percentile.
eligibility.ageLimit: Minimum 17 years. The upper age limit for NEET has been removed by the Supreme Court.
eligibility.boardRequirements: Passed 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Biotechnology, and English. General: 50%, Reserved: 40%.
eligibility.attempts: Currently, there is no limit on the number of attempts for NEET-UG.

process: Step 1: Appear for NEET-UG conducted by NTA and secure a qualifying rank.
Step 2: Register on mcc.nic.in during the announced counseling window and pay the registration & security fees.
Step 3: Fill choices of colleges and courses (MBBS/BDS/B.Sc Nursing) in order of preference.
Step 4: Lock choices before the strict deadline (auto-locks if you forget, but manual locking is safer).
Step 5: Seat Allotment result processing and declaration by MCC.
Step 6: Download the allotment letter from the MCC portal.
Step 7: Physical reporting to the allotted medical college with all original documents and fee payment.
Step 8: Submit willingness for upgradation to Round 2 or 3 if you are not satisfied with the current seat.
rounds: Round 2: Typically held in August (Allows upgradation and fresh registrations).
Round 3 (Mop-Up): Typically held in September (Fresh registrations allowed).
Stray Vacancy Round: Typically held in late September/October (No fresh registrations; seats allotted based on merit to registered candidates).
documents: Class 10 Certificate & Marksheet (for Date of Birth)
8 Passport size photographs (same as affixed on application form)
Category Certificate (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS) in central govt format
PwD Certificate issued by specified disability assessment boards

fees.tuitionGovernment: Ranges from ₹1,356 (AIIMS) to ₹1,00,000 per year depending on the state.

seatMatrix.totalAIQSeats: Approximately 15% of ~60,000 total government MBBS seats + 100% of Central/Deemed seats.
seatMatrix.reservation: SC: 15%, ST: 7.5%, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer): 27%, EWS: 10%, PwD: 5% Horizontal.
seatMatrix.location: Seat matrix PDFs are uploaded on mcc.nic.in under 'eServices' before Choice Filling begins.

commonMistakes: Paying ₹2,00,000 security deposit for Deemed Universities without intending to join them.
Uploading state-format OBC/EWS certificates instead of Central Government formats.
Forgetting to lock choices, causing anxiety (though auto-locking exists, manual locking is advised).
Not reporting physically to the allotted college, resulting in forfeiture of the security deposit in later rounds.
studentTips: Fill maximum choices! Even if you want a specific state, add other good AIQ colleges below your preferences.
Order matters: MCC software checks your Choice 1, then Choice 2. Prioritize college reputation and patient load over pure city locations.
Check the exact bond status of the state you are applying to via AIQ. AIQ students must also serve state bonds.

dghs.role: The technical wing of the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare. It oversees the Medical Counselling Committee (MCC).

nmc.role: Replaced the Medical Council of India (MCI) in 2020. It approves medical colleges, sets MBBS curriculum, and dictates fee guidelines for 50% of private college seats.

dci.role: Apex body regulating dental education and the profession of dentistry throughout India, including BDS and MDS programs.

counselingBody.name: Directorate of Medical Education and Training, UP

stateQuota.eligibility: Candidates who passed 10th and 12th from UP, OR whose parents are permanent residents of UP (domicile required if passing outside).

process: Payment of Registration Fee and Security Deposit (CRITICAL in UP).
Download Allotment Letter and Physical Reporting at Nodal Center.
documents: CTS Bank Draft for Security Deposit

bond.details: Mandatory 2-year rural service bond for all Govt MBBS students. Penalty is ₹10 Lakhs.

stateCounseling.seatMatrix: Available on upneet.gov.in before Round 1 choice filling.
commonMistakes: Failing to make the Bank Demand Draft (DD) for security deposit properly. It must be in the exact name specified by UPDGME.
Not realizing UP is an 'Open State'—meaning non-domiciles can apply for UP Private Medical Colleges.
studentTips: UP has many new government medical colleges (Autonomous State Medical Colleges/ASMCs). They lack alumni networks but have great infrastructure.
If applying for private colleges, investigate hidden charges (hostel, mess, miscellaneous fees).
whileYouWait: Prepare the security deposit Demand Draft well in advance from a nationalized bank.
stateCounseling.motivation: UP has the largest number of medical seats in India. The sheer volume means cutoffs can drop in Mop-Up rounds. Stay patient and trust the process!

financialAid.scholarships: UP Post Matric Scholarship for SC/ST/OBC students studying in Govt colleges.

counselingBody.name: State Common Entrance Test Cell, Maharashtra

stateQuota.eligibility: Must have passed 10th and 12th from Maharashtra AND possess a Maharashtra Domicile Certificate.

bond.details: 1-year compulsory rural service in Maharashtra Govt hospitals or ₹10 Lakhs penalty. Applicable to Govt and Govt-Aided colleges.

commonMistakes: Not obtaining the Caste Validity Certificate. MH is very strict; without it, you are treated as General.
Filling 'Status Retention Form' too early, which blocks you from subsequent upgrade rounds.
studentTips: If you are satisfied with your seat, fill the Status Retention Form. If you want an upgrade, DO NOT fill it.
KEM and JJ Hospital are among the best medical institutions in Asia.
whileYouWait: Ensure your Non-Creamy Layer (NCL) certificate is valid up to March 31 of the admission year.
backupOptions: BAMS in Maharashtra is highly respected and regulated.
BDS in Govt Dental Colleges (Mumbai, Nagpur).
stateCounseling.motivation: Maharashtra has incredibly transparent counseling and a huge number of seats. Your hard work will find a place here. Don't stress if CAP 1 cutoffs look high; they drop significantly.

financialAid.scholarships: EBC (Economically Backward Class) Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti Yojna gives 50% tuition fee waiver in private colleges.

stateQuota.eligibility: 7 years of study in Karnataka including 10th/12th, or parents' domicile rules.

documents: Study Certificate (7 years) counter-signed by BEO

bond.details: Mandatory 1-year rural service for all students studying in Govt colleges AND Govt-quota seats in private colleges.

commonMistakes: Ignoring the Mock Allotment. Mock allotment is crucial to understand what college you might actually get.
Not getting the study certificate counter-signed by the Block Education Officer (BEO).
studentTips: Karnataka is an 'Open State'. Non-domiciles can apply for Private (Open) quota seats at ~11 Lakhs/year, which is cheaper than many other states.
St. John's Medical College has its own separate reservation matrix but uses KEA for counseling.
whileYouWait: Run to the BEO office and get your 7-year study certificates verified and signed.
backupOptions: Karnataka has India's best private medical colleges if MBBS Govt is missed.
stateCounseling.motivation: Bengaluru is a hub of world-class medical infrastructure. Securing a seat here provides unmatched clinical exposure. You've got this!

financialAid.scholarships: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST via SSP Portal.

counselingBody.name: Selection Committee, Directorate of Medical Education

documents: First Graduate Certificate (if applicable for fee waiver)

bond.details: Govt college students must serve 5 years in Govt service or pay ₹5 Lakh penalty. (Rules subject to recent revisions, verify current TN Govt Order).

commonMistakes: Not utilizing the 7.5% reservation for students who studied 6th to 12th in TN State Govt Schools.
Applying with fake nativity certificates (highly penalized).

Madras Medical College (MMC) is one of the oldest and most prestigious in Asia.

ayush.courses: BSMS (Siddha is huge here), BAMS, BHMS

backupOptions: BSMS (Siddha Medicine) is highly respected and lucrative in Tamil Nadu.
stateCounseling.motivation: Tamil Nadu produces some of the finest doctors globally. The 7.5% govt school quota is a golden ticket for rural students. Keep your hopes high!

financialAid.scholarships: First Graduate Fee Concession, Post Matric Scholarships.

counselingBody.name: Dr. YSR University of Health Sciences

documents: Study Certificates (6th to 12th) to prove Local Area
Income Certificate for Jagananna Vidya Deevena (Fee Reimbursement)

bond.details: 1 year of mandatory government service for Govt MBBS students.

commonMistakes: Not understanding the AU vs SVU local area distinction. You are 'Local' to only one region and 'Unreserved' for the other.

backupOptions: BDS or B.Sc Nursing. Private 'A' category MBBS seats are highly affordable if you secure one on merit.

financialAid.scholarships: Jagananna Vidya Deevena (Full Fee Reimbursement for eligible low-income families).

counselingBody.name: State Medical and Dental Counseling Board, Rajasthan

stateQuota.eligibility: Bonafide resident of Rajasthan (Mool Niwas required).

process: Reporting to SMS College Jaipur for Verification/Joining

fees.tuition: Govt (State Quota): ~₹50,000 - ₹1,00,000/year. Govt (Management Quota in Govt Society Colleges): ~₹8,00,000/year. Private: ₹15,00,000+/year.

bond.details: 2 years of service for students passing out of Govt/Society colleges.

cutoffs.govtMbbsGen: Very High in RJ. Usually ~620+ marks.

commonMistakes: Rajasthan has a unique 'Govt Management' seat category in its RajMES society colleges costing ~8 Lakhs/year. Do not mistake this for the standard 50k/year govt seat during choice filling!
studentTips: SMS Medical College Jaipur is a top-10 India institute.
Cutoffs in Rajasthan are notoriously high due to heavy local competition (the 'Kota factor'). Have backup states or AIQ choices ready.
whileYouWait: Keep a Demand Draft ready for offline rounds at SMS Medical College, as spot decisions require immediate payment.
backupOptions: Applying for low-fee private colleges in open states like Karnataka or Kerala.
stateCounseling.motivation: Rajasthan produces some of the sharpest medical minds in India. The competition is tough, but cracking it means you are truly among the best. Don't let high cutoffs deter your spirit!

officialLinks.portal: Check Department of Medical Education Rajasthan site for current year link.
